access.robots: none published at https://credentialengineregistry.org/robots.txt (HTTP 404); RFC 9309 2.3.1.3 allows it

exclusion_reasons.duplicate-ctid: a page drawn earlier carried the same CTID
exclusion_reasons.fetch-failed: the envelope page could not be fetched (message recorded)
exclusion_reasons.no-document: the envelope carries no CTID or no decoded_resource
exclusion_reasons.not-resource-data: the envelope's type is not resource_data
exclusion_reasons.unreadable: the document is not a shape the validator reads (exit 2)

protocol.resolve: one hop; every referenced /resources/ URI on the Registry host, nothing else
